title: 艾瑞森 风 R1使用体验
notes: Owner post (edited 2025-06-26): 28C clincher about 235 g; 28.2 and 28.4 mm wide on a 19 mm internal rim; more dry grip ('sticks to the asphalt') and more stable at speed than a Michelin Power Cup, slower to accelerate and comfortable. The owner had not ridden it in the wet. Commenters: one had a large sideslip on a 28C tubeless version in a corner (conditions not stated); one measured about 27 mm at 95 psi; per-tire prices of CNY 160 and later 218 were mentioned.
